narrative: The Langroid flaw is a clean instance of the core mechanism: an in-the-loop agent steered by injected content, directly or via poisoned data it later reads, coerced into exfiltrating or destroying data it holds privileged access to. The exploited LiteLLM injection reinforces that text-to-SQL agents are a live exfiltration surface.
remaining_gap: Today's flaws are framed as prompt-to-SQL-to-RCE, not CI/secret-leakage incidents, and no CIS/OWASP ranking movement appears, leaving the list-topping claim untouched.
